back: Income and expenses are recognised in the period in which they are earned or incurred, not when cash is received or paid.
Do not overstate assets or profit, or understate liabilities; recognise expected losses now and gains only when realised.

Items too small to affect users' decisions can be treated in the simplest way (e.g. expensing a stapler).
